name: revnu
description: GTM on autopilot. Approve what Revnu drafted, hand it the next job and read what worked, from the chat.

interface.longDescription:
Revnu runs a company's growth: it finds buyers, reaches them in the founder's voice, runs paid ads, and gets the business showing up in AI answers. This app brings that work into ChatGPT.

Ask what's waiting and the review queue opens in the chat as cards. Each one is a drafted reply, a blog post ready to publish, or an ad budget change. You approve, send, snooze, request changes or dismiss it without leaving the conversation. Nothing goes out without your say-so, unless you've told Revnu that kind of work may ship on its own.

What you can do from ChatGPT:
- Review queue: list, open, approve, send, snooze, request changes on or dismiss cards.
- Hand over a job: ask Revnu to do something ("find 20 fintech CFOs in London", "draft a post on our pricing change") and check how it's going.
- Results: read what each channel produced (meetings, replies, ad spend and conversions, pages ranking).
- Pipeline: list leads, open one, set its labels.
- Block list: see, add and remove people and domains Revnu must never contact.
- Workflows: create, change, pause, resume or delete recurring work, and read its runs.

Every tool acts on your own Revnu account, with the permissions you grant when you connect. Each connected app gets its own token, which you can revoke in Settings → API Tokens.
